```{r Load in Libraries/Data}
song_list <- read_csv("data/spotlistr-exported-playlist.csv")
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(shiny)
library(wesanderson)
```

```{r Converting Length to Seconds}
song_list <- song_list |>
                separate(Length, into = c("h", "m", "s"), sep = ":", remove = FALSE) |>
                mutate(m = as.numeric(m),
                       s = as.numeric(s),
                       total_sec = m * 60 + s)
song_list$h <- NULL # removing hours as they're all 0
```

song_list$plays <- plays

song_list <- song_list |>
      mutate(total_secs_played = plays * total_sec,
             total_mins_played = total_secs_played / 60,
             total_hours_played = total_mins_played / 60)

sum(song_list$total_hours_played)

```{r Manually Adding Gender}
# Options: Cis Men, Cis Women, Mixed/Other (m, w, o)
# Mixed/Other includes multiple people of different genders, nonbinary/genderfluid people, trans people, etc

song_list$gender <- c("w", "w", "w", "o", "m", "w", "w", "m", "m", "w", 
                      "w", "o", "w", "o", "w", "o", "w", "o", "w", "w",
                      "w", "w", "o", "w", "w", "o", "o", "m", "m", "w",
                      "o", "w", "w", "m", "w", "w", "w", "w", "m", "o",
                      "w", "o", "m", "m", "w", "m", "w", "w", "w", "o",
                      "m", "m", "w", "m", "w", "w", "w", "m", "w", "m",
                      "m", "w", "w", "w", "w", "w", "w", "w", "m", "m",
                      "w", "o", "w", "w", "m", "w", "m", "w", "w", "w",
                      "w", "w", "w", "m", "w", "w", "o", "m", "w", "w",
                      "m", "w", "o", "w", "m", "w", "w", "w", "m", "w")

# it was just easier to input the values as single letters (I did this by hand)
song_list <- song_list |> 
      mutate(gender = case_when(gender == "w" ~ "Woman",
                                gender == "m" ~ "Man",
                                gender == "o" ~ "Mixed/Other"))
```

```{r Plays Distribution}
# Creating a global font for all future distributions
global_font <- list(family = "Verdana",
                    color = "#000000")

# Set new color scheme
wes_colors1 <- wes_palette("GrandBudapest1", n = 4)

# Dictate tooltip text
song_list <- song_list |>
      mutate(text = paste0("<b>", Track.Name, "</b><br>",
                           Arist.s..Name, "<br>",
                           "Plays: ", plays, "<br>",
                           "Gender: ", gender))
# Prepare ggplot frame
p1 <- song_list |>
      ggplot(aes(x = plays, fill = gender, text = text)) +
      geom_histogram(binwidth = 2) +
      theme_bw() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = wes_colors1[c(1, 2, 3)]) +
      labs(fill = "Gender")

# Arrange ggplot & text into plotly
ggplotly(p1, tooltip = "text") |>
      layout(plot_bgcolor = "white",
             paper_bgcolor = wes_colors1[4],
             font = global_font,
             title = list(text = "<b>Women Dominated My Top 100 Tracks This Year</b><br><sub>(My Top 100 Songs, Spotify Wrapped 2025)</sub>",
                          font = global_font),
             xaxis = list(title = "Plays",
                          titlefont = global_font,
                          tickfont = global_font),
             yaxis = list(title = "Number of Songs",
                          titlefont = global_font,
                          tickfont = global_font),
             legend = list(font = global_font),
             margin = list(t = 100))
```
```{r}
# Dictate tooltip text
song_list <- song_list |>
      mutate(text7 = paste0(Arist.s..Name, "<br>",
                           "Age: ", artist_age))
p7 <- song_list |>
  group_by(artist_age, Arist.s..Name, text7) |>
  distinct(Arist.s..Name) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = artist_age, text = text7)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, fill = wes_colors1[1]) +
  theme_bw()

# Arrange ggplot & text into plotly
ggplotly(p7, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(plot_bgcolor = "white",
         paper_bgcolor = wes_colors1[4],
         font = global_font,
         title = list(text = "<b>Most Artists I Listen to Are in Their 20-30's</b><br><sub>(My Top 100 Songs, Spotify Wrapped 2025)</sub>",
                      font = global_font),
         xaxis = list(title = "Artist Age (years)",
                      titlefont = global_font,
                      tickfont = global_font),
         yaxis = list(title = "Number of Artists",
                      titlefont = global_font,
                      tickfont = global_font),
         legend = list(font = global_font),
         margin = list(t = 100))
```

```{r Gender bar distribution}
# Dictate tooltip text & calculate percentages
top_25_summary <- song_list |>
      slice(1:25) |>
      count(gender) |>
      mutate(pct = n / sum(n),
             text = paste0("<b>", gender, "</b><br>", 
                           n, " songs (", scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 1), ")"))

# Arrange ggplot & text into plotly
plot_ly(data = top_25_summary,
        y = ~gender,
        x = ~pct,
        type = "bar",
        orientation = "h",
        marker = list(color = c(wes_colors1[1], wes_colors1[2], wes_colors1[3])),  # Match order of gender levels),
                      text = ~text,
                      hoverinfo = "text",
                      textposition = "outside",
                      texttemplate = "%{x:.0%}",
                      textfont = global_font) |>
        layout(plot_bgcolor = "white",
               paper_bgcolor = wes_colors1[4],
               font = global_font,
               title = list(text = "<b>My Top 25 is Comprised of Primarily Non-male Artists</b><br><sub>(My Top 100 Songs, Spotify Wrapped 2025)</sub>",
                            font = global_font),
               xaxis = list(title = "Gender",
                            titlefont = global_font,
                            tickfont = global_font,
                            tickformat = ".0%",
                            range = c(0, 0.7)),
               yaxis = list(title = "",
                            titlefont = global_font,
                            tickfont = global_font),
               showlegend = FALSE,
               margin = list(t = 100, r = 50))
```

```{r Length Distribution}
# Set new color scheme
wes_colors2 <- wes_palette("GrandBudapest2", n = 4)

# Dictate tooltip text
song_list <- song_list |>
  mutate(text = paste0( total_sec, " seconds long<br>"))

# Prepare ggplot frame
p2 <- song_list |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_sec, text = text)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = wes_colors2[1]) +
  theme_bw()

# Arrange ggplot & text into plotly
ggplotly(p2, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(plot_bgcolor = "white",
         paper_bgcolor = wes_colors2[2],
         font = global_font,
         title = list(text = "<b>Most Songs I Listen To Are 2-4 Minutes Long</b><br><sub>(My Top 100 Songs, Spotify Wrapped 2025)</sub>",
                      font = global_font),
         xaxis = list(title = "Song Length (seconds)",
                      titlefont = global_font,
                      tickfont = global_font),
         yaxis = list(title = "Number of Songs",
                      titlefont = global_font,
                      tickfont = global_font),
         legend = list(font = global_font),
         margin = list(t = 100))
```

```{r length v. plays scatter/bubble}
# Set new color scheme
wes_colors3 <- wes_palette("Darjeeling1", n = 3)

# Dictate tooltip text / setup line of best fit
song_list <- song_list |>
      mutate(text = paste0("<b>", Track.Name, "</b><br>", 
                           Arist.s..Name, "<br>",
                           "Length: ", round(total_sec / 60, 2), " min<br>", 
                           "Plays: ", plays),
             fitted = predict(lm(plays ~ total_sec, data = song_list)))

# Prepare ggplot frame
p4 <- song_list |>
        ggplot(aes(x = total_sec, y = plays)) +
        geom_point(aes(text = text),
                   color = wes_colors3[3],
                   alpha = 0.8,
                   size = 2) +
        geom_line(aes(y = fitted),
                  color = wes_colors3[1],
                  linewidth = 1) +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# Arrange ggplot & text into plotly
ggplotly(p4, tooltip = "text") |>
    layout(plot_bgcolor = "white",
           paper_bgcolor = wes_colors3[2],
           font = global_font,
           title = list(text = "<b>Song Length Had Almost No Effect on Replay Behavior</b><br><sub>(My Top 100 Songs, Spotify Wrapped 2025)</sub>",
                        font = global_font),
           xaxis = list(title = "Song Length (seconds)",
                        titlefont = global_font,
                        tickfont = global_font),
           yaxis = list(title = "Number of Plays",
                        titlefont = global_font,
                        tickfont = global_font),
           margin = list(t = 100))
```

```{r}
# Dictate tooltip text
song_list <- song_list |>
                mutate(text = paste0("<b>", Track.Name, "</b><br>", Arist.s..Name, "<br>",
                                     "Total time: ", round(total_mins_played, 1), " minutes<br>", 
                                     "Plays: ", plays))

# Prepare ggplot frame
p4 <- song_list |>
        ggplot(aes(x = total_mins_played, text = text)) +
        geom_histogram(binwidth = 30,
                       fill = wes_colors3[3],
                       alpha = 0.7,
                       color = "white") +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 240,
                   linetype = "dashed",
                   linewidth = 0.8,
                   color = wes_colors3[1]) +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# Arrange ggplot & text into plotly
ggplotly(p4, tooltip = "text") |>
      layout(plot_bgcolor = "white",
             paper_bgcolor = wes_colors3[2],
             font = global_font,
             title = list(text = "<b>Most Songs Were Not Played for More Than Four Hours</b><br><sub>(Cumulative listening time per track — Top 100 Songs, Spotify Wrapped 2025)</sub>",
                          font = global_font),
             xaxis = list(title = "Total Minutes Listened per Song",
                          titlefont = global_font,
                          tickfont = global_font),
             yaxis = list(title = "Number of Songs",
                          titlefont = global_font,
                          tickfont = global_font),
             margin = list(t = 100),
             annotations = list(x = 245, # 4 hour cutoff line
                                y = 0.75,
                                yref = "paper",
                                text = "4 hours",
                                xanchor = "left",
                                yanchor = "top",
                                showarrow = FALSE,
                                font = global_font))
```

```{r}
artist_summary <- song_list |>
                mutate(Arist.s..Name = str_trim(Arist.s..Name, side = "right"),
                       Arist.s..Name = case_when(grepl("Saja", Arist.s..Name) ~ "K-Pop Demon Hunters Cast",
                                                 grepl("HUNTR/X", Arist.s..Name) ~ "K-Pop Demon Hunters Cast",
                                                 TRUE ~ Arist.s..Name)) |>
                separate_rows(Arist.s..Name, sep= "; ") |>
                mutate(genre = case_when(Arist.s..Name %in% c("TWICE", "K-Pop Demon Hunters Cast") ~ "K-Pop",
                                         Arist.s..Name %in% c("Maroon 5", "COIN", "Neon Trees") ~ "Pop Rock",
                                         Arist.s..Name %in% c("Lady Gaga", "Sabrina Carpenter", "Kesha", "FLETCHER", "Chappell Roan", "Chrissy Chlapecka") ~ "Pop",
                                         Arist.s..Name == "Mercer Henderson" ~ "R&B/Soul",
                                         Arist.s..Name %in% c("bbno$", "Doechii") ~ "Rap",
                                         Arist.s..Name == "KiNG MALA" ~ "Alt Pop",
                                         TRUE ~ NA_character_))

artist_summary <- artist_summary |>
                    group_by(Arist.s..Name) |>
                    summarise(n = n(),
                              genre = first(genre)) |>
                    filter(n >= 2) |>
                    arrange(desc(n)) |> 
                    mutate(text6 = paste0("<b>", Arist.s..Name, "</b><br>",
                                          "Songs: ", n, "<br>",
                                          "Genre: ", genre))


genre_colors <- c("K-Pop" = "indianred1",
                  "Pop Rock" = "darkgoldenrod2",
                  "Pop" = wes_colors2[4],
                  "Rap" = "olivedrab",
                  "R&B/Soul" = wes_colors2[1],
                  "Alt Pop" = "darkslateblue")

plot_ly(data = artist_summary,
        x = ~reorder(Arist.s..Name, n),
        y = ~n,
        type = "bar",
        color = ~genre,
        colors = genre_colors, 
        text = ~text6,
        hoverinfo = "text") |>
        layout(plot_bgcolor = "white",
               paper_bgcolor = wes_colors2[2],
               font = global_font,
               title = list(text = "<b>I Listen to Mostly Pop and its Subgenres</b><br><sub>(Artists With at Least 2 Appearances — My Top 100 Songs, Spotify Wrapped 2025)</sub>",
                            font = global_font),
               xaxis = list(title = "",
                            showticklabels = FALSE,
                            titlefont = global_font,
                            tickfont = global_font),
               yaxis = list(title = "Number of Songs",
                            titlefont = global_font,
                            tickfont = global_font),
               showlegend = TRUE,
               legend = list(title = list(text = "<b>Genre</b>"),
                             font = global_font),
               margin = list(t = 100))
```
